nina (BillingOps): FYI found ~15 Stripe invoices posted with incorrect tax_code in NetSuite (US_SALES instead of VAT_EU). Started after last night's webhook mapper tweak.

kai (Eng): looking. We updated the mapper to accept `region` instead of `country` for routing. Some events have `region` set to upper case (EU) and our lookup is case-sensitive -> defaulted tax_code.

sam (Finance): That could break our VAT filing. How many customers and timeframe?

nina (BillingOps): 15 invoices across 6 EU customers, window 2024-07-03T22:05 -> 22:40 UTC.

support-bot: [ALERT] 15 invoices created with fallback tax_code since 2024-07-03T22:05Z. See /alerts/6421.

kai (Eng): quick mitigation: patch mapper to lowercase region keys and fall back to `country` when region lookup fails. Will deploy a fix now.

nina (BillingOps): Can we backfill safely? Must not change invoice numbers or payments.

kai (Eng): Backfill plan: idempotent upsert by external_id, only update `tax_code` and `subsidiary` where they differ, attach memo `CORR: tax-code-mapper`. Dry-run first: `./tools/ns_backfill --ids /tmp/tax_ids.txt --fields tax_code --dry-run`.

sam (Finance): share dry-run sample payload for audit.

kai (Eng): dry-run sample: `{"external_id":"stripe_inv_A1","tax_code":"VAT_EU","metadata":{"region":"EU"}}`

sam (Finance): sample ok. Proceed when dry-run shows only updates, no duplicates.

kai (Eng): dry-run OK. Running full backfill now (2024-07-03T23:10Z). Will post outcome.

support-bot: [BACKFILL] 15 invoices processed, 15 updated. Audit log: /backfills/taxcode_20240703.log

sam (Finance): spot-checked GLs and VAT buckets. Corrections look good. We'll include note in next VAT report.

nina (BillingOps): action items: add alert for region-case mismatches, keep country fallback, and add unit-test for region casing. Closing once tax report updated.
